composition: horizontal multi-panel grid with warplane left
description: Multi-panel collage assembled from paper fragments, iridescent foil, pencil sketches, and compact discs mounted on a warplane silhouette at left. Central and right sections incorporate pencil-drawn landscapes, blue iridescent panels, small adhesive labels, and a circular ornament sketch against white and silver grounds.
title: Untitled (Warplane with Discs) 2
